name: parallelize_loop
description: Distribute independent loop iterations across multiple CPU cores using coarse-grain parallelism. Targets outer loops in structured operations (matmul, convolution) that are inherently parallelizable. Applies OpenMP-style loop parallelization via MLIR Transform dialect.

parameters.name: operation_tag
parameters.description: Tag attribute value identifying the target operation (e.g., 'matmul', 'conv_2d'). Used to locate the operation to parallelize.

parameters.name: loop_depth
parameters.description: Depth of the loop nest to parallelize (0-indexed from outermost). Typically 0 or 1 for outer parallel loops.

parameters.name: num_threads
parameters.description: Number of threads to use for parallelization. Should not exceed physical core count (28 for target machine). If 0, uses system default.
